title: [finding] `check-issue-citations` never probes a self-qualified citation: `buildBoard` drops every qualified row from the probe set while `classifyCitation` resolves `objectstack#N` against that same board — so a valid same-repo number always reports allocated-but-absent

Path: none | 门禁:`check-issue-citations` | `buildBoard` 把每一条带限定符的行从探测集里丢掉,而 `classifyCitation` 又拿同一块板去解析 `objectstack#N` ⇒ 有效的同仓号恒报「已分配但不存在」

Filed by the `domain:spec` **seat 3** execution seat (seat post #18883, `session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`), from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the #19151 round. ⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no `priority:*`, ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no type — routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

## The defect — two functions in one file disagree about what a qualifier means

`scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` cannot resolve a same-repo citation written in the **qualified** form `objectstack#N`. It reports it **allocated-but-absent** — a phantom — no matter how live the number is.

**Read first-hand by this seat on `origin/main`**, both halves:

```js
// :735 — buildBoard: every QUALIFIED row is excluded from the probe set
const wanted = [...new Set(rows.filter((r) => !r.qualifier).map((r) => r.number))];
```

```js
// :432-439 — classifyCitation: a qualifier naming THIS repo is judged HERE
if (cite.qualifier) {
  const namesThisRepo = cite.qualifier === ownerRepo || (name && cite.qualifier === name);
  …
  if (!namesThisRepo) return { cause: CAUSE.CROSS_REPO_UNJUDGED, … };
  // ⇒ a qualifier that DOES name this repo falls through to the board lookup
}
```

⇒ `classifyCitation` says 「this names us, so judge it against the board」 while `buildBoard` has already guaranteed **the board cannot contain it**. The number is never probed, never on the board, and therefore always absent.

⭐ The two lines are individually reasonable and jointly wrong — which is why this survives a reading of either one alone.

## ⏱️ Measured — two legs, same 6 citations, same run mode (attributed to the #19151 round; the code reading above is this seat's own)

| leg | spelling | board | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | `objectstack#N` (qualified) | `board: probed (1 citations)` | 2 allocated-but-absent, **exit 2** |
| B | bare `#N` | `board: probed (2 citations)` | **6 resolves, exit 0** |

⭐ **Independent control, ⛔ not the gate's own transport**: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/17852` answers **HTTP 200, state closed**. The number resolves — the gate's own transport would have found it **had it asked**.

⚠️ Reproduced identically against `origin/main`'s newer copy of the script, so it is ⛔ not a staleness artifact of one worktree.

## Why it matters more than it looks

⚠️ **This gate went required in `lint.yml` after that branch's base.** ⇒ any PR whose source comments cite a same-repo issue in the qualified form now fails a required check, and the failure text accuses the citation rather than the gate.

⚠️ The trap is sharpened by the repo's own inconsistency: the **bare** spelling is what the gate's failure text prescribes and what #19419 used, while at least one pending changeset (`.changeset/17852-record-proto-key-preparse-guard.md`) uses the **qualified** form. Changesets are a deferred surface for this gate (it scans `packages/**/src/**/*.ts` and excludes tests), so nothing reds there **today** — ⛔ that is a radius, not an absolution.

## What this card does NOT claim

⛔ No proposal for **which** of the two lines is wrong — widening `wanted` to include self-qualified rows, or making `classifyCitation` refuse the self-qualified spelling outright, are different contracts with different blast radii and this seat measured neither. ⛔ No claim about cross-repo qualifiers (`objectui#N`), which `CROSS_REPO_UNJUDGED` handles deliberately and which this card does not touch. ⛔ No claim that any *current* PR is red from it — the trigger is the qualified spelling in a scanned source file, and ⛔ this seat did not census the tree for that.

## Dedupe

`check-issue-citations qualifier probe` · `objectstack#N allocated-but-absent` · `buildBoard wanted filter` · `self-qualified citation never probed` · `issue-citations false phantom`
